notes:
Summary:
- Proxima Dev Assist builds an IDE copilot (editor plugin) + backend indexing service for multi-repo code search. Primary focus: sub-100ms interactive completion and <80ms keystroke streaming for active editors, plus large nightly embedding refresh for their code indexing pipeline.

Environment & constraints:
- Multi-tenant service: central inference tier for copilot streaming (low latency) + separate batch fleet for nightly embedding refresh (high throughput).
- Data residency: repo metadata and embeddings must be stored in NA/EU regions (customer chooses region per org).
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for token usage, KMS integration for key management.
- Prefer VPC connectivity for Dedicated; evaluating hosted first to speed PoC.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria:
- Interactive copilot: 50-100ms stable p95 for single-token streaming on typical 32B-quant model variant or optimized 7B low-latency variant.
- Background embedding pipeline: target 1M files/day, sustained background throughput ~150 qps across shards during peak refresh window; ability to auto-batch and horizontal scale.
- Model/version pinning: must be able to pin model versions for cohorts and rollback automatically on quality regressions.
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to cheaper variants when dedicated capacity is saturated; deterministic canary for new model versions.
- Caching: prefix/KV cache for session context to reduce token compute on repeated completions.
- Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency, and tracing into pipeline stages for backfill jobs.

Notes from calls / timeline:
- 2024-10-15 discovery call (Dev Lead: Aaron Mullins, AE: Maya Chen): quick product intro, described low-latency streaming need. Quote from Aaron: "Keystroke lag kills adoption — if it's >80ms users notice."
- 2024-10-29 demo: showed hosted streaming API, batching knobs. Customer asked about model pin + canary flows.
- 2024-11-05 POC kickoff (ff-20241105-1093): run sample workload (editor traffic emulation) against dedicated 2-node pool and background embedding job to validate batching and auto-scaling.
- 2024-11-12 perf results: prototype 7B quant variant achieved p95 ~95ms with optimized kernels; nightly embedding job hit 650k files in 6h using 200 shard workers (notes in /drive/proxima).
- Security review started 2024-11-10: Sent SOC2 + architecture diagram. Legal flagged retention and data residency questions.

Open items / POC plan:
- SE (Jamal) to run a 48hr churn test simulating editor sessions (concurrent 4k users) and produce p50/p95/p99. Action: Jamal by 2024-11-20.
- Customer to provide sample repo snapshot for embedding accuracy regression checks.
- Redwood to provide cost projection for 3 configurations: hosted bursts, dedicated reserved (monthly commit), private VPC.

Quotes / customer priorities:
- "If you can give us predictable p95 under 80ms and a rolling-rollback model pin, we're ready to commit to dedicated capacity."

Next steps (short):
- Confirm POC schedule and credentials for VPC peering test.
- Complete security questionnaire (legal) and hand to Redwood security by 2024-11-22.
- Deliver perf report and cost model (by 2024-11-25).
